description: Create and manage AI-generated images, videos, audio, scripts, art settings and storyboard content with Mango LingChuang.

display.description_en: Use Mango LingChuang's AI video creation capabilities from the command line. Generate images, audio (music, score, dubbing), and videos with 30+ models, manage timbres, projects, scripts, art settings and storyboards, and track task status and results.
display.description_zh: 通过命令行调用芒果灵创 AI 视频创作能力：可使用 30+ 模型生成图片、音频（音乐、音效、配音）和视频，管理音色库、项目、剧本、美术设定与分镜故事板，跟踪任务状态和生成结果。
examples_en: Generate a cinematic video of a rainy street after the rain
Generate a song that celebrates ordinary people
Create a voiceover for this scene: an ordinary person walks down a rainy street looking for their friend. Narration: 'An ordinary person is looking for their friend.'
Create a new project and upload a script
Extract character settings from the script and generate character images
Break the script into text scripts and upload them to the storyboard
Generate storyboard images from storyboard text scripts
View the project's SD-compliant asset library
examples_zh: 生成一段雨后街道的电影感视频
生成一首歌颂平凡人物的音乐
给这个场景生成一段配音：一个普通人在雨后街道上走着，他正在找他的朋友。旁白：“一个平凡的普通人正在找他的朋友。”
创建一个新的项目并上传剧本
根据剧本提取人物设定并生成角色形象图
将剧本拆解为文字脚本并上传到分镜故事板
根据分镜文字脚本生成分镜图
查看项目中的 SD 合规素材库内容
display.name: 芒果灵创 CLI
